history.name: Three documents from one record
history.description: The record generates three plain-language documents that stay current with it: the client-facing list of what the product does, the same list with the technical notes folded in under each entry for anyone working in the codebase, and a separate one for the internal work a client never sees. Each is grouped into areas in reading order, largest capabilities first, with every entry tagged by size — so what the client reads and what the team reads can never drift apart, because they come from the same source.
history.dev_notes: src/render/markdown.mjs — MarkdownRenderer#all() returns features / extended / dev; filenames configurable under config.output.
